list: Official 55 trophies — guide written 21 Nov 2026 from PowerPyx, Exophase, GameSpot, damnmodz, gamemapa and PushSquare
verified_count: 54 of 55 unlock methods confirmed; 1 honestly unknown (Ten Pin)
rarity_note: Rarity: Exophase, 20 Nov 2026 — early player base, floor 0.01%; numbers move fast in launch week
gamerscore_note: Xbox total 1,000G (GamesRadar+ via gamemapa); per-trophy Gamerscore not published per trophy in the sources read

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed for the platinum.
Follow the 7-stage roadmap in this guide: story first, then strangers, crimes, activities, collections, robberies, and the 100% checklist cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. The trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.
There is no way to miss a story trophy: each one unlocks by finishing its mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter closes after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only trophy that can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish Chapter 2. The chapter closes after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
From Chapter 2 onward you can swap between Jason and Lucia, which most partner trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish Chapter 3. It closes after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer (Credit Check) and the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs) — both gate later trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish Chapter 4. Its last mission is Starting From Zero.
The optional bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is opens in Chapter 4 — it feeds Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Free roam opens after the credits.
Save manually at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Finish the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Open the checklist after the story ends: Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
The checklist has three weights: Story and Tasks 45%, Exploration and Activities 45%, Discovery 10%. Roughly 60% true completion is enough for 100% on the counter.
Nothing on the checklist is missable. Work through it in the roadmap's stage 7: story tasks, gang operations, bank jobs, collections, stunts, races and discovery.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Finish any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridge, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps. Categories can be mixed.
Under the Bridge stunts are the fastest to grind. Track each category under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
For 100% you need 300 stunts, so this trophy pops on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Range, Pool, Basketball (score a hoop), Playing a Video Game, winning a car Race, Race Challenge or Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt.
Track it under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Almost all of these happen naturally while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 locations (18 at Griffin, 24 elsewhere).
Raise your Focus first — it makes the timed shots far easier. The 5-second shooting-range loop also farms Focus quickly.
This is the second-hardest trophy after A Long Road, so leave it for the activities stage, not the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total).
Use the PowerPyx location guide for all 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations and work through them in one sweep.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations.
Car races, Race Challenges and Top Fun Drone Races all count, so mix the easiest of each type.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline until you beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Finish any one of the 4 arcade video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three can be played on the home TV with a controller from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on an arcade machine out in the world.
You must finish every level of the game — you do not need every challenge.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges listed under Progress, Challenges.
100% needs 70 of 80, so pick the easiest ones first and let this trophy pop on the way to the platinum.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold D-pad Up + R1).
Any locations count — there are more than 100: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total).
100% needs 15 of 18 sets, so use the PowerPyx guide for all 18 set locations and keep collecting past this trophy.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan 100 unique vehicles with WAiNK (hold D-pad Up, aim at the vehicle, hold R1). You do not need to drive them — scanning is enough.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives past. There are 557 vehicles in total; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned.
Track it under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations. Meditating as BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, which halves the work.

Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she says she will meditate, and choose Accept. This is the ONLY potentially missable trophy — it is gone once Chapter 1 ends.
Track spots under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. 100% only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18.

Open question, shown honestly: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is not proven whether it is required. Do it anyway — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Andy's questline is Lucia-only, from Chapter 3. Wait for Andy's call, then follow his text to his house in Belville.

Finish all 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
Available after the story ends, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Start in Chapter 1: after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), Kenton calls and a green KR icon appears in Key Lento.
He gives treasure-diving quests (7 shipwrecks in total): find the underwater treasure with the metal detector and bring it back to Kenton. After each set he calls again for the next.
Kenton is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1, then returns in Chapters 2–3 (as Jason, call Brian to speed it up). Track him under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Billy's questline opens in Chapter 2, after the mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish all 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Complete 8 stranger mission strands that the game counts. Warning: many questlines do NOT count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others have their own trophies instead.

Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove / Advanced Skunk Apeonomics); Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy? / Check on Kyle); Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper / Mentor Yago, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother / Back Up Yago); Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield, Pete's Deliveries: Avery Allen and Co., Deliver Packages).
PowerPyx notes more strangers may still be undiscovered — use the in-game trophy tracker to confirm what counts.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Randy's Wish List opens in Chapter 3, after Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner and delivers the Zorrusso automatically.

Randy then wants 16 sports cars: Granforma Zorrusso, Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee, Gallivanter Baller ST-D.

Steal them off the street (often around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, in front of hotels) or from marked spots; scan with WAiNK to check a car is on the wishlist, then deliver it to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Better condition means better pay.
Track it on the map under Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Tyrone's questline opens in Chapter 3 (Jason only), after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty: a purple Synthetic Labs marker appears in Vice City.
Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) — finishing it pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Bret Vogel's questline opens in Chapter 2 (Jason only), after Coffee Break: a text from Bret marks the first quest Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County.

Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — pick it up in an Ammu-Nation weapon locker. He marks hunting spots with a purple icon; hunt the animal he asks for and bring it back to him.
One clean shot means pristine condition and better pay (not required). Track the 15 Target Decks under Map, Activities, Target Deck — 100% needs all 15, so this trophy comes free with the cleanup.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Earliest after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, once you can free-roam as a pair. Call your partner with hold D-pad Right + Triangle.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape until you are out of the red heat zone — not just the flashing blue/red search area.
Easiest spot: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County). Police struggle to follow on the rails and helicopters cannot see you there. A fast sports bike with sharp turns works too.
It usually pops naturally while robbing a large bank vault (always a 4-star wanted level) in the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, rob 3 shops in a row while the police are chasing you. Keep the wanted level flashing red/blue — do not let it enter the solid red heat level.
Bring body armor, sticky bombs, and Zombix or Adrenaline. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Rob a few items and blow the back safe with a sticky bomb.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming. Take down 5 enemies in ONE use — time slows for only a few seconds.

Prepare: raise Focus first (eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home), take Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the duration, use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 (accurate, full-auto), and wear body armor.
Fight 5 enemies standing close together, such as criminals in Gang Operations. It does NOT work on soldiers, police or civilians.

Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Focus, purple eye icon) — raise it via Shooting Range, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots. At Focus Level 4 this is much easier, and it often pops naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Steal a large passenger plane attached to a boarding bridge at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — NOT a plane sitting on the field. The easiest are at terminals E3/E4.
Get in through the airfield fence, climb the stairs beside the boarding bridge (the door leads straight into the plane), or walk in through the terminal.
Inside: go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane onto the runway, take off, and fly at least 1 km from the airport until the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
Honesty note: whether this trophy is hidden is NOT verified — it is one of the two candidates for the unidentified 16th hidden non-story trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Steal a military Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station (the island in the south-west of the map, Mariana County; tanks are in the south of the base).
Enter through the gate or via the stunt jump in the south-east. Climb in, then shoot enemies until the trophy pops — if it does not, fire the cannon.
Honesty note: whether this trophy is hidden is NOT verified — it is the other candidate for the unidentified 16th hidden non-story trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun (silently lockpick alarmed doors; it stays in your inventory permanently, no need to equip it) and jewelry store robberies (green icons in opened areas).
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — do NOT kick the door in, that triggers the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds, Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: First finish the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe) — the introduction to bank vault robbery.
Follow a security van until it stops at a bank; a guard carries a bag into the vault; enter while the vault is open and rob it. Bring your partner (hold D-pad Right to hand over one bag).
After the quest, pay Yasmani (the Chapter 3 fence; finish his 2 Payday Loans robberies first) $10,000 for security-van locations (purple icons).

Robbing a vault triggers a 4-star wanted level immediately — escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; the trophy needs 5, 100% needs 8. One bank can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: SAFEST ROUTE: do it through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is — robbing the large bank vault in that mission counts as robbing an armored truck.

FASTER ROUTE (buggy): block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a sticky bomb on the back door, blow it, and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold behind Yasmani's shop after his quest.
BUG WARNING: this trophy can fail to pop if you rob a truck directly (damnmodz). If it fails, use the bank-vault route instead.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Clear all the fog from the map.
Fastest way: fly a plane over every black fogged area until the full map is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Rob 1 Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; 100% needs all 39).
Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get close; many are marked automatically during the story.
Track it under Progress, Gangs — scroll each gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed at the bottom right.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar at the Oceanview Hotel, Ocean Beach — walk past the pool and take the lift to the rooftop.
Buy an Apple Martini ($10) at the rooftop bar and drink it while standing next to the bar.
SOLVED 20 Nov evening (PowerPyx update) — before that, every guide listed this trophy as unknown. The rooftop bar is also where the Ocean View Hotel easter egg sits.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: First get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City. Clone the key of the blue Banshee (Bravado Banshee).
Drive straight through the showroom window and keep driving until the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Steal 3 valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation): the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 (north-east corner table), and the safe in the north-east corridor (blow it with a sticky bomb — buy one at Ammu-Nation first).
The trophy pops AFTER you escape the police, not when you take the third item.

The optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling marks the location. NOT missable: if you do not finish everything in one visit, the robbery icon respawns after a while — come back and steal the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Reach MAXIMUM Strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength (heart icon).
Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, once you can swap characters.
Raise Strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon; many in Vice City) or work out at home after the story.
Always bring your partner (hold D-pad Right + Triangle): while one character works out, the other progresses automatically, so progress doubles.
DISAGREEMENT: ofzenandcomputing calls this a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign; PowerPyx and the majority say it is about maximum Strength. This guide follows PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Track it by clicking the trophy in the trophy list (it shows X/500).
Turn on notifications: Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On — every reputation-affecting action then shows a small devil-face icon on the right of the screen.

Profiles: Professional (finish objectives and robberies quietly, destroy evidence, escape cleanly), Hardened (disable enemies without killing — shoot limbs), Violent (kill enemies or civilians), Psycho (kill many police or civilians, run over graves), Irredeemable (PERMANENT — constant extreme violence; police become more aggressive).
It almost always pops naturally. If you are short, the fastest farm is running over civilians or police with a car — but beware: Psycho or Irredeemable makes police shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: SOLVED 20 Nov evening (PowerPyx update). Go back to the Payday Loans shop in Little Cuba, Vice City — the one Lucia robbed in the Prologue — as Lucia ALONE (without Jason).
Rob it again like in the prologue (aim a weapon at the teller, take the money), then escape ON FOOT (not in a vehicle). The trophy pops after a delay — keep running.
DISAGREEMENT on timing: PowerPyx says earliest is Chapter 2 (once you can play as Lucia); damnmodz says after getting the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3 is the best lead. Try Chapter 2 first.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: SOLVED 20 Nov evening. After Chapter 1, go ALONE to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County (east of Port Gellhorn), AFTER 02:00 in-game time.
Look for a parked car with flashing lights at the roadside. If there is none, leave and come back — the spawn is random.

Follow the trail of clothes into the woods toward a blue light: a UFO is lifting a woman. Help her (agree to fetch her car), walk back to the car on the road — the UFO returns and abducts YOUR character, and the trophy pops.

Works as Jason or Lucia. SECOND ENCOUNTER (not a trophy, but related): after the abduction your character dreams — note the number above the keypad in the dream (usually 2134). Go to South Point Airfield, Hamlet — the radio tower (climb the fence from the left), up the ladder to the roof, in through the hatch, down, enter the code, take the lift to the basement, press the panel buttons until all lights are green, pull the lever, take the milk bottle from the table (through the left door, watch for radiation), put it in the capsule in the right room — a small grey alien appears. Carry it out before the poison gas, return to the lift; a UFO comes to collect the alien.

NOTE: one source (TechTudo via Cut.pro) claims the Capri satanic ritual opens this same trophy. PowerPyx and GameSpot say the UFO abduction does. Both cannot be true — this guide follows the UFO (2+ strong sources) and lists the ritual claim as unverified in the Easter Eggs section.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: HONESTLY UNKNOWN — the only trophy whose unlock is still unverified as of 21 Nov 2026, 00:30 WIB.
Best lead (PowerPyx): kick an enemy during a melee drive-by from a motorcycle. No source has proven the exact steps yet.
Do not trust any guide that states exact steps for this trophy as fact — this guide will not invent them.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob Banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a Fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most).
The $250,000 total is cumulative — it does not have to be at once. It comes naturally while doing all the robberies for 100%. One bank vault alone can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. Fastest: weapons, car mods, and tattoos (the most expensive).
Shops: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear, 18 Hair and Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (total $160,000; 4 story garages do not count).
Garages become buyable after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone. Buy through the app.
Fastest money: robberies, especially in Chapters 3–4. See the PowerPyx guide for all 12 garage locations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It registers stolen vehicles so you can call them to your location.
You need a garage first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking slots. Take a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click Respray, then Register in his garage.
At first Moses only accepts vehicles without a tracker; from Chapter 3 you can register standard tracked cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money — use cheap cars and bikes to save cash.
